claims.text: The Senado Federal's own profile gives his civil name as 'Luis Eduardo Grangeiro Girão', born 25/09/1972 in Fortaleza, Ceará, serving the period 2019-2027 for Ceará.

claims.sourceText: Senado Federal, perfil do Senador Eduardo Girão, checked 25 August 2026 https://www25.senado.leg.br/web/senadores/senador/-/perfil/5976
claims.text: As of the date this was checked the Senate lists him as 'Fora de Exercício' - on leave with a substitute convened, his seat held by first substitute Sargento Reginauro. Any present-tense claim on this board about him acting as a sitting senator should be read against that.
